where is loch ness | what country is loch ness in | loch ness location => Loch Ness is in the Scottish Highlands, near the city of Inverness.
how big is loch ness | size of loch ness | how deep is loch ness => Loch Ness is about 37 kilometers (23 miles) long and about 230 meters (750 feet) deep.
what is loch ness known for | facts about loch ness => Loch Ness is famous for the legend of the Loch Ness Monster, or Nessie. It holds more water than all the lakes in England and Wales put together.
where is lake geneva | lake geneva location | what country is lake geneva in => Lake Geneva is on the border between Switzerland and France.
what is lake geneva known for | facts about lake geneva => Lake Geneva has a giant fountain, the Jet d'Eau, that shoots water about 140 meters (460 feet) into the air.
where is lake como | lake como location | what country is lake como in => Lake Como is in northern Italy, near the Alps.
what is lake como known for | facts about lake como => Lake Como is shaped like an upside-down Y and is famous for villas and movie filming.
where is great bear lake | what country is great bear lake in | great bear lake location => Great Bear Lake is in Canada's Northwest Territories.
how big is great bear lake | size of great bear lake | how deep is great bear lake => Great Bear Lake covers about 31,000 square kilometers (12,000 square miles).
what is great bear lake known for | facts about great bear lake => Great Bear Lake is the biggest lake entirely inside Canada.
where is lake ladoga | lake ladoga location | what country is lake ladoga in => Lake Ladoga is in northwestern Russia, near St. Petersburg.
what is lake ladoga known for | facts about lake ladoga => Lake Ladoga is the biggest lake entirely in Europe.
where is lake chad | what country is lake chad in | lake chad location => Lake Chad is in Africa, where Chad, Cameroon, Niger and Nigeria meet.
what is lake chad known for | facts about lake chad => Lake Chad has shrunk to a small part of its size from the 1960s because of drought and people using its water.
where is lake nicaragua | lake nicaragua location | what country is lake nicaragua in => Lake Nicaragua is in southern Nicaragua.
what is lake nicaragua known for | facts about lake nicaragua => Lake Nicaragua is the biggest lake in Central America, and it's one of the only freshwater lakes with bull sharks.
where is lake mead | lake mead location | what country is lake mead in => Lake Mead is on the Colorado River, between Nevada and Arizona, near Las Vegas.
what is lake mead known for | facts about lake mead => Lake Mead was made by the Hoover Dam, and it's the biggest reservoir in the United States when it's full.
where is lake okeechobee | what country is lake okeechobee in | lake okeechobee location => Lake Okeechobee is in southern Florida.
what is lake okeechobee known for | facts about lake okeechobee => Lake Okeechobee is the biggest freshwater lake in Florida, and its water flows south into the Everglades.
# tag: geo.waterfall
where is niagara falls | niagara falls location | what country is niagara falls in => Niagara Falls is on the Niagara River, on the border between Ontario, Canada, and New York State.
how tall is niagara falls | how high is niagara falls | how big is niagara falls => Niagara's Horseshoe Falls is about 51 meters (167 feet) tall, but it's very wide and carries a huge amount of water.
what is niagara falls known for | facts about niagara falls => Niagara Falls is three waterfalls: Horseshoe Falls, American Falls and Bridal Veil Falls. In 1901, Annie Edson Taylor became the first person to go over it in a barrel and survive.
where is victoria falls | victoria falls location | what country is victoria falls in => Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi River, on the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe.
how tall is victoria falls | how big is victoria falls | how high is victoria falls => Victoria Falls is about 108 meters (355 feet) tall and about 1,700 meters (5,600 feet) wide, which makes it the biggest single sheet of falling water in the world.
what is victoria falls known for | facts about victoria falls => Local people call Victoria Falls Mosi-oa-Tunya, which means The Smoke That Thunders, because of its giant spray cloud.
where is iguazu falls | what country is iguazu falls in | iguazu falls location => Iguazu Falls is on the border between Argentina and Brazil.
how tall is iguazu falls | how big is iguazu falls | how high is iguazu falls => Iguazu Falls is made of about 275 separate waterfalls spread over almost 3 kilometers (1.7 miles).
what is iguazu falls known for | facts about iguazu falls => The biggest part of Iguazu Falls is a U-shaped cliff called the Devil's Throat. Iguazu means Big Water in the Guaraní language.
where is yosemite falls | what country is yosemite falls in | yosemite falls location => Yosemite Falls is in Yosemite National Park, in California.
how tall is yosemite falls | how big is yosemite falls | how high is yosemite falls => Yosemite Falls drops about 739 meters (2,425 feet) in total, making it one of the tallest waterfalls in North America.
what is yosemite falls known for | facts about yosemite falls => Yosemite Falls is fed by melting snow, so it's strongest in spring and can dry up in late summer.
where is kaieteur falls | what country is kaieteur falls in | kaieteur falls location => Kaieteur Falls is on the Potaro River in the rainforest of Guyana.
how tall is kaieteur falls | how high is kaieteur falls | how big is kaieteur falls => Kaieteur Falls drops about 226 meters (741 feet) in one single drop.
what is kaieteur falls known for | facts about kaieteur falls => Kaieteur Falls is one of the most powerful waterfalls in the world because it's both tall and carries lots of water.
where is tugela falls | what country is tugela falls in | tugela falls location => Tugela Falls is in the Drakensberg mountains of South Africa.
how tall is tugela falls | how high is tugela falls | how big is tugela falls => Tugela Falls drops about 948 meters (3,110 feet) in total, and it's often called the second tallest waterfall in the world.
where is gullfoss | gullfoss location | what country is gullfoss in => Gullfoss is on the Hvítá River in southwest Iceland.
what is gullfoss known for | tell me about gullfoss | facts about gullfoss => Gullfoss means Golden Falls. Its water drops in two steps into a deep canyon.
where is rhine falls | what country is rhine falls in | rhine falls location => The Rhine Falls is on the Rhine River in northern Switzerland, near Schaffhausen.
how tall is rhine falls | how big is rhine falls | how high is rhine falls => The Rhine Falls is about 23 meters (75 feet) tall and 150 meters (490 feet) wide.
what is rhine falls known for | facts about rhine falls => The Rhine Falls is the biggest plain waterfall in Europe, meaning it's the widest and carries the most water.
where is angel falls | what country is angel falls in | angel falls location => Angel Falls is in Canaima National Park in Venezuela.
what is angel falls known for | facts about angel falls => Angel Falls is named after Jimmie Angel, an American pilot who flew over it in 1933. Its water falls so far that much of it turns into mist before reaching the bottom.
# tag: geo.ocean
where is the pacific ocean | pacific ocean location | what continents touch the pacific ocean => The Pacific Ocean lies between Asia and Australia on the west and the Americas on the east.
how big is the pacific ocean | size of the pacific ocean | area of the pacific ocean => The Pacific covers about 165 million square kilometers (64 million square miles), bigger than all the land on Earth put together.
facts about the pacific ocean | what is special about the pacific ocean => The Pacific has the deepest point on Earth, the Challenger Deep, and it was named "peaceful sea" by Ferdinand Magellan.
where is the atlantic ocean | atlantic ocean location | what continents touch the atlantic ocean => The Atlantic Ocean lies between the Americas on the west and Europe and Africa on the east.
how big is the atlantic ocean | area of the atlantic ocean | size of the atlantic ocean => The Atlantic covers about 106 million square kilometers (41 million square miles), the second biggest ocean.
facts about the atlantic ocean | what is special about the atlantic ocean => The Atlantic is getting a little wider every year, by a few centimeters, because the Mid-Atlantic Ridge is spreading apart. The Titanic sank in it.
where is the indian ocean | indian ocean location | what continents touch the indian ocean => The Indian Ocean lies between Africa, Asia, Australia and Antarctica.
how big is the indian ocean | area of the indian ocean | size of the indian ocean => The Indian Ocean covers about 70 million square kilometers (27 million square miles), the third biggest ocean.
facts about the indian ocean | what is special about the indian ocean => The Indian Ocean is the warmest ocean in the world.
where is the southern ocean | southern ocean location | what continents touch the southern ocean => The Southern Ocean surrounds Antarctica.
how big is the southern ocean | size of the southern ocean | area of the southern ocean => The Southern Ocean covers about 21 million square kilometers (8 million square miles), the fourth biggest ocean.
facts about the southern ocean | what is special about the southern ocean => The Southern Ocean was officially recognized as the fifth ocean by National Geographic in 2021, and it has the strongest ocean current, the Antarctic Circumpolar Current.
where is the arctic ocean | what continents touch the arctic ocean | arctic ocean location => The Arctic Ocean surrounds the North Pole, north of Europe, Asia and North America.
how big is the arctic ocean | area of the arctic ocean | size of the arctic ocean => The Arctic Ocean covers about 14 million square kilometers (5.4 million square miles), the smallest and shallowest ocean.
facts about the arctic ocean | what is special about the arctic ocean => Much of the Arctic Ocean is covered by sea ice, which is shrinking as the climate warms.
# tag: geo.sea
where is the mediterranean sea | mediterranean sea location => The Mediterranean Sea lies between southern Europe, North Africa and Western Asia. It connects to the Atlantic through the Strait of Gibraltar.
how big is the mediterranean sea | area of the mediterranean sea | size of the mediterranean sea => The Mediterranean covers about 2.5 million square kilometers (970,000 square miles).
facts about the mediterranean sea | what is the mediterranean sea known for => The name Mediterranean means "in the middle of the land", and it was the center of ancient Greek and Roman life.
where is the caribbean sea | caribbean sea location => The Caribbean Sea lies south of Cuba and east of Central America, and north of South America.
how big is the caribbean sea | area of the caribbean sea | size of the caribbean sea => The Caribbean Sea covers about 2.75 million square kilometers (1 million square miles).
facts about the caribbean sea | what is the caribbean sea known for => The Caribbean has thousands of islands, coral reefs, and lots of hurricanes in summer and fall.
where is the red sea | red sea location => The Red Sea lies between Africa and the Arabian Peninsula.
facts about the red sea | what is the red sea known for => The Red Sea is one of the saltiest seas, with amazing coral reefs, and it connects to the Mediterranean through the Suez Canal.
where is the black sea | black sea location => The Black Sea lies between Eastern Europe and Western Asia, bordered by Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia and Georgia.
facts about the black sea | what is the black sea known for => The Black Sea's deep water has almost no oxygen, so old shipwrecks on its floor stay very well preserved.
where is the caspian sea | caspian sea location => The Caspian Sea lies between Europe and Asia, bordered by Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran and Azerbaijan.
how big is the caspian sea | area of the caspian sea | size of the caspian sea => The Caspian Sea covers about 371,000 square kilometers (143,000 square miles).
facts about the caspian sea | what is the caspian sea known for => The Caspian Sea is called a sea, but it's really the biggest lake in the world. It's where most of the world's caviar came from.
where is the baltic sea | baltic sea location => The Baltic Sea lies in northern Europe, surrounded by Sweden, Finland, Russia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Germany and Denmark.
facts about the baltic sea | what is the baltic sea known for => The Baltic Sea is less salty than most seas because lots of rivers flow into it, and its shores are famous for amber.
where is the north sea | north sea location => The North Sea lies between Great Britain, Norway, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium and France.
facts about the north sea | what is the north sea known for => The North Sea has oil and gas fields and lots of wind farms.
where is the south china sea | south china sea location => The South China Sea lies south of China, between Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia and Borneo.
facts about the south china sea | what is the south china sea known for => The South China Sea has some of the world's busiest shipping lanes, and several countries argue over who owns its islands.
where is the arabian sea | arabian sea location => The Arabian Sea is part of the Indian Ocean, between the Arabian Peninsula and India.
where is the coral sea | coral sea location => The Coral Sea is part of the Pacific Ocean, off the northeast coast of Australia.
facts about the coral sea | what is the coral sea known for => The Coral Sea is home to the Great Barrier Reef.
where is the bering sea | bering sea location => The Bering Sea lies between Alaska and Russia, in the far north of the Pacific.
facts about the bering sea | what is the bering sea known for => The Bering Strait at its north end is only about 82 kilometers (51 miles) wide, and the TV show Deadliest Catch was filmed there.
where is the sargasso sea | sargasso sea location => The Sargasso Sea is in the North Atlantic Ocean, near Bermuda.
facts about the sargasso sea | what is the sargasso sea known for => The Sargasso Sea is the only sea with no coastline. It's bordered by ocean currents instead and is full of floating seaweed called sargassum.
where is the gulf of mexico | gulf of mexico location => The Gulf of Mexico is bordered by the US Gulf Coast, Mexico and Cuba. In 2025 the US government started calling it the Gulf of America.
how big is the gulf of mexico | area of the gulf of mexico | size of the gulf of mexico => The Gulf of Mexico covers about 1.6 million square kilometers (600,000 square miles), the biggest gulf in the world.
facts about the gulf of mexico | what is the gulf of mexico known for => Rivers like the Mississippi and the Rio Grande flow into the Gulf, and it gets many hurricanes.
where is the bay of bengal | bay of bengal location => The Bay of Bengal is part of the Indian Ocean, between India, Bangladesh, Myanmar and Sri Lanka.
facts about the bay of bengal | what is the bay of bengal known for => The Bay of Bengal is the biggest bay in the world.
where is the hudson bay | hudson bay location => Hudson Bay is in northeastern Canada, surrounded by Nunavut, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec.
facts about the hudson bay | what is the hudson bay known for => Hudson Bay freezes over in winter, and polar bears hunt seals on its ice.
where is the persian gulf | persian gulf location => The Persian Gulf lies between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula.
facts about the persian gulf | what is the persian gulf known for => Countries around the Persian Gulf hold a huge share of the world's oil, and ships leave it through the narrow Strait of Hormuz.
where is the english channel | english channel location => The English Channel is the strip of sea between southern England and northern France.
how big is the english channel | area of the english channel | size of the english channel => The English Channel is only about 33 kilometers (21 miles) wide at its narrowest point, the Strait of Dover.
facts about the english channel | what is the english channel known for => The Channel Tunnel, or Chunnel, runs under the English Channel and lets trains go between England and France.
